correctness.rationale: The published support equation is differentiated at the exact stationary constant solution. The first variations \(\delta r=\varphi\) and \(\delta b=\bar\nabla^2\varphi+\varphi\bar g\) are direct. The published formula \(\dot G^{ii}=-\kappa_i^2\sigma_{k-1}(\kappa|i)\) gives \(DG=-(k\beta/n)R_*^{-k-1}\operatorname{tr}\), and the stationary identity \(f_0R_*^{\alpha-k-1}=1\) yields \(L=(k\beta/n)\bar\Delta-\beta(\alpha-k-1)\). The standard Laplacian spectrum gives every eigenvalue. Degree zero agrees with the source's exact homothetic ODE and degree one independently agrees with \(\delta b=0\). No finite experiment is used as proof.
